name: Turn and stop on command
short_description: Turn and stop on command once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can turn and stop on command in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Turn and stop on command means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Turn and stop on command in a fresh real-life scenario.
